NYC weather: Brighter and breezy | AccuWeather forecast - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut Weather 
 AccuWeather: Brighter and breezy 
 AccuWeather forecast for NYC, New York, New Jersey and Connecticut 
 The weekend will feel noticeably cooler, but it will not be a washout. Dani Beckstrom has the latest on today's forecast. WABC By Eyewitness News Share Follow abc7NY on Google NEW YORK (WABC) -- Sunday looks like the standout day of the weekend. While a brisk breeze will make it feel cool, expect brighter skies and dry conditions, with afternoon temperatures near 60 degrees.
 Looking ahead, Monday remains breezy and cooler, with highs around 58 and the possibility of an isolated shower, particularly north of the city. Tuesday appears to be the pick of the week, featuring a pleasant mix of sun and clouds, continued breezy conditions, and temperatures climbing into the mid-60s. Veterans Day on Wednesday also looks favorable, with highs around 61 degrees and a mix of sunshine and high clouds.
 We are keeping a close eye on a developing weather system that could approach the region Thursday into Friday. While details are still coming into focus, a more unsettled stretch of weather late next week remains possible. One trend that appears increasingly likely is the arrival of the season's coldest air behind the system. High temperatures could fall from around 50 degrees next Friday into the 40s by next weekend, signalling a much more wintry feel across the area.
